text:
[4. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 19, 2026, relative to donations valued at $2,000.00 to
  support Hollywood Community Police Station’s Baker to Vegas, as set forth.  [BPC #26-326]

summary: The commission is asked to approve a report on $2,000 in donations that support the Hollywood Community Police Station's Baker to Vegas effort.
